newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed lower in all months on Thursday, as bearish sentiment remained following Wednesday's price plunges, traders said.
Prices were 30 to 490 yen lower, with the benchmark September 1997 contract down 100 yen at 17,700.
Traders said they expected a renewed wave of selling from local investors due to price losses on the CBOT corn market overnight.
"But many investors thought the Tokyo market fell too much yesterday and hesitated to sell" a brokerage trader said.
The spot September contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $3.59 per bushel at 0910 GMT, against $3.58-3/4 at Wednesday's close.
The spot September CBOT soybean futures contract on the overnight trading system was at $8.01-1/2 per bushel at 0910 GMT, from $7.97-3/4 at Wednesday's close.
